PROJECT_DIR=$SCRATCH/{{:dir_name}}/

# Note: Using flux run instead of mpiexec for better integration with Flux.
# The -n value should match the {{:ncpus}} template variable after rendering.
flux run -n {{:ncpus}} julia --project=$PROJECT_DIR --check-bounds no -O3 \
    $PROJECT_DIR/scripts/Benchmarks/benchmark_gadi.jl \
    {{:name}} \
    {{{:write_dir}}} \
    {{:type}} \
    {{:bmark_type}} \
    {{:Nx_partition}} \
    {{:Ny_partition}} \
    {{:Nz_partition}} \
    {{:n_el_size}} \
    {{:fe_order}} \
    {{:verbose}} \
    {{:nreps}}
